name: Ronald Fairbairn (W.R.D. Fairbairn)
shortBio: Scottish psychiatrist and psychoanalyst who revolutionized psychoanalytic drive theory by establishing that libido is fundamentally object-seeking rather than pleasure-seeking.
centralQuestion: Is psychic motivation fundamentally oriented toward bodily drive discharge or toward relational connection with another human being?

keyWorks.title: Psychoanalytic Studies of the Personality
keyWorks.description: Magnum opus proposing an endopsychic structural model based entirely on internalized object relations.

keyWorks.title: A Revised Psychopathology of the Psychoses and Psychoneuroses
keyWorks.description: Establishes schizoid mechanisms and splitting of the ego as the primary foundation of psychic pathology.

keyWorks.title: The Repression and the Return of Bad Objects
keyWorks.description: Demonstrates that what is repressed is not impulses in isolation, but dynamic internalized bad object ties.
